summary: Daily agent radar: three vendor-level updates (GitHub Actions protections GA; Agentic CLI usage metrics; Anthropic Claude Code patch), multiple operator reports on MCP/memory scaling and agent safety, and new/updated local-memory and session-indexing infra projects.

candidates.title: GitHub: Workflow execution protections in Actions generally available
candidates.why_it_matters: Adds guardrails for agent-driven CI workloads; reduces risk of uncontrolled workflow runs.
candidates.next_check: Read full docs for breaking changes and agent-specific guidance; watch for exploit mitigations in follow-up posts.

candidates.title: GitHub: Agentic CLI customizations now in usage metrics API
candidates.why_it_matters: Enables measuring agent CLI features and custom workflows for operator telemetry.
candidates.next_check: Check API docs and telemetry schema; confirm whether private-scope usage is supported.

candidates.title: Anthropic: Claude Code v2.1.276 release
candidates.why_it_matters: Patch release for Claude Code (vendor-side update affecting coding agents).
candidates.next_check: Scan changelog for security or behaviour changes affecting MCP/tooling compatibility.

candidates.title: Productionizing Agentic GenAI on AWS: MCP scaling failures
candidates.why_it_matters: Field report details concrete MCP scaling breakages and operator workarounds on AWS.
candidates.next_check: Look for corroborating threads or sample configs; request perf/incident metrics from author.

candidates.title: Plugin4Shell: zero-click RCE affecting top coding agents
candidates.why_it_matters: Operators must patch or isolate vulnerable agent integrations to prevent remote RCE.
candidates.next_check: Confirm vendor advisories/patches and list of affected agent builds; escalate if no fixes in 48h.

candidates.title: coding_agent_session_search: unified TUI/CLI session indexer
candidates.why_it_matters: Search local agent session history across 11+ providers for faster troubleshooting.
candidates.next_check: Verify security model for stored sessions and MCP/provider credentials.

candidates.title: AVIDS2/memorix: cross-agent memory layer
candidates.why_it_matters: Open-source memory layer compatible with many coding agents for shared context storage.
candidates.next_check: Check adoption notes and how it handles credentialed tools and PII in memory.

candidates.title: MemWhale: persistent local memory for coding agents (SQLite + MCP)
candidates.why_it_matters: Records commands, outputs and fixes locally; helps recover agent state after crashes.
candidates.next_check: Confirm compatibility list for providers and review data retention/security defaults.

candidates.title: OpenAI Codex: v0.155.0 release
candidates.why_it_matters: Vendor release for Codex runtime used by many coding-agent stacks.
candidates.next_check: Scan release notes for behavioural/security changes affecting agent orchestrators.

candidates.title: Dev: 'I got tired of babysitting coding agents' — operator loop pain
candidates.why_it_matters: Concrete workflow friction: frequent human intervention and monitoring drains ops time.
candidates.next_check: Collect corroborating anecdotes or telemetry showing babysitting overhead.

candidates.title: Failed compaction wiped AI session; user built infinite memory
candidates.why_it_matters: Real operator incident: durable session storage is fragile; recovery patterns shared.
candidates.next_check: Verify underlying storage software/version and postmortem details.

candidates.title: nexus-mcp: local MCP server for invoking CLI agents
candidates.why_it_matters: MCP server claims parallel execution, retries, structured output for CLI agent tooling.
candidates.next_check: Needs independent corroboration (user thread or integration example); re-check in 48h.

candidates.title: Flip-Engineering/baton: deterministic coordinator for vendor CLIs
candidates.why_it_matters: Proposes trust-gated session workers across multiple vendor coding CLIs; early proto.
candidates.next_check: Only single-repo evidence; request usage examples or community reports before promoting.

candidates.title: OpenAI agent incidents reported across threads and blogs
candidates.why_it_matters: Multiple reports of agents performing unsafe or unexpected actions; operational risk.
candidates.next_check: Track official OpenAI incident response and vendor guidance; list affected agent versions.
